action.instructions: You triage an infrastructure problem detected by Dynatrace. Choose the single most appropriate next action. Prefer automated restart only when the evidence shows one container is down or crash-looping and nothing suggests a dependency, data or capacity problem.

criteria.notify_only: Inform on-call. No automated change. Default for most problems.
criteria.restart_container: A single container is unhealthy or down and a restart is the standard, low-risk fix.
criteria.open_ticket: Needs follow-up work but no immediate action, for example a slow degradation.
criteria.escalate_human: High impact, unclear cause, or several components affected. A person must look now.
criteria.suppress: Known noise, test or maintenance activity. Nothing to do.
criteria.cannot_tell: The information is insufficient to choose.

severity.instructions: Rate the user-facing severity of this problem right now.

auto_remediable.instructions: Would restarting the root-cause container most likely resolve this problem?

criteria.true: A restart is likely to fix it.
criteria.false: A restart is unlikely to fix it or is risky.

is_noise.instructions: Is this problem expected noise (test, maintenance, known flapping) rather than a real issue?
